Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5050844. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return only rows with available canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
